## 1. Reconciliation

**Shopify is the order/revenue source of truth; GA4 allocates those orders by last click, not causal impact.** Summing platform claims does not deduplicate orders.

**Important:** TikTok’s export omits July 1–14 and includes October 1–14. Therefore, the comparisons below are **as supplied, not fully period-matched**. Costs, blended results and the Q4 budget baseline remain provisional until that export is corrected.

| Channel | Platform conversions | Shopify orders | Excess orders (%) | Platform revenue | Shopify revenue | Excess revenue (%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Meta | 610 | 330 | 280 (84.8%) | $79,300 | $41,250 | $38,050 (92.2%) |
| Google Search | 540 | 420 | 120 (28.6%) | $75,600 | $56,700 | $18,900 (33.3%) |
| Google PMax | 470 | 260 | 210 (80.8%) | $61,100 | $33,280 | $27,820 (83.6%) |
| TikTok* | 220 | 90 | 130 (144.4%) | $24,200 | $9,900 | $14,300 (144.4%) |
| Affiliate | 260 | 210 | 50 (23.8%) | $33,800 | $27,720 | $6,080 (21.9%) |
| Email | 380 | 250 | 130 (52.0%) | $47,500 | $35,000 | $12,500 (35.7%) |
| Direct / organic | — | 80 | — | — | $9,350 | — |
| **Total** | **2,480** | **1,640** | **840 (51.2%)** | **$321,500** | **$213,200** | **$108,300 (50.8%)** |

Channel differences reflect attribution disagreements as well as possible duplication. The total gap includes direct/organic orders; it is not a count of individually identified duplicates.

## 2. Formulas and channel scorecard

| Metric | Formula |
|---|---|
| Excess / over-attribution | Platform claim − Shopify actual |
| Excess % | Excess ÷ Shopify actual × 100 |
| True cost | Spend + applicable fees |
| Channel ROAS | GA4-attributed Shopify revenue ÷ true cost |
| CAC proxy | True cost ÷ GA4-attributed Shopify orders |
| Contribution | Shopify revenue × 55% − true cost |
| Blended ROAS | Total Shopify campaign revenue ÷ total campaign cost |
| Break-even ROAS | 1 ÷ 55% = **1.82×** |
| Q4 budget constraint | Sum of channel budgets = supplied spend + fees = **$139,500*** |

“CAC” below is actually **cost per order**, since new-customer counts are unavailable. Contribution is before other overhead, not net profit.

| Channel | True cost* | GA4 orders | GA4 revenue | ROAS | CAC proxy | Contribution | Verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Meta | $42,000 | 330 | $41,250 | 0.98× | $127 | −$19,313 | Last-click loss; holdout supports incremental demand |
| Google Search | $36,000 | 420 | $56,700 | 1.58× | $86 | −$4,815 | Below break-even; optimize before scaling |
| Google PMax | $28,000 | 260 | $33,280 | 1.19× | $108 | −$9,696 | Reduce; investigate brand capture |
| TikTok* | $18,000 | 90 | $9,900 | 0.55× | $200 | −$12,555 | Weak supplied results; correct window first |
| Affiliate | $13,000 | 210 | $27,720 | 2.13× | $62 | $2,246 | Positive after $4,000 fee; scale selectively |
| Email | $2,500 | 250 | $35,000 | 14.00× | $10 | $16,750 | Strong observed economics; capacity unproven |
| Direct / organic | $0† | 80 | $9,350 | — | — | $5,143 | Include in blended results, not paid-channel ranking |

\* TikTok’s $18,000 is the supplied mismatched-window cost, not verified Q3 cost.  
† No direct/organic cost was supplied; this does not establish that acquisition was free. Calculations use unrounded values.

## 3. Corrected board headline

| Measure | Corrected result | Status |
|---|---:|---|
| Campaign-tagged orders | **1,640** | Shopify actual |
| Campaign-tagged revenue | **$213,200** | Shopify actual |
| Total cost | **$139,500*** | $135,500 supplied spend + $4,000 affiliate fee |
| Blended ROAS | **1.53×*** | Includes direct/organic revenue |
| Total contribution | **−$22,240*** | $117,260 margin dollars − $139,500 cost |

**Corrected headline:** “Autumn Launch recorded 1,640 campaign-tagged orders and $213,200 in revenue, with a provisional 1.53× blended ROAS and −$22,240 contribution against supplied costs, pending TikTok period alignment.”

The draft’s **2.37×** uses summed platform revenue and excludes the affiliate fee. For an exact Q3 correction, substitute aligned TikTok cost **T**: total cost = **$121,500 + T**; contribution = **−$4,240 − T**.

## 4. Q4 budget recommendation

Use **$139,500 as the provisional planning envelope**, not a mandate to spend regardless of returns. Release increases in stages against incremental contribution and capacity checks.

| Channel | Q4 budget | Change vs supplied cost | Rationale and attribution interpretation |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Meta | $42,000 | $0 | Maintain while validating the 14% holdout lift. Last click may under-credit demand later converted through search, email or direct. |
| Google Search | $36,000 | $0 | Hold, but redirect toward profitable queries/products. Separate brand from nonbrand; brand last click may over-credit demand created elsewhere. |
| Google PMax | $18,000 | −$10,000 | Cut pending brand-exclusion testing. The 35% brand-query share suggests possible demand capture, not proof those conversions were nonincremental. |
| TikTok | $4,000 | −$14,000 | Test-only budget after correcting dates. Last click may miss discovery effects, but current evidence does not support scale. |
| Affiliate | $28,000 | +$15,000 | Includes assumed $4,000 fee and $24,000 commissions. Expand productive partners; coupon/checkout interception can over-credit affiliates. |
| Email | $11,500 | +$9,000 | Fund lifecycle, segmentation and creative tests—not simply more sends. Last click can credit purchases that would happen anyway. |
| **Total** | **$139,500** | **$0** | Maintain the envelope; gate deployment on results. |

## 5. Caveats and next tests

| Priority | Caveat / next action |
|---|---|
| 1 | Re-export TikTok for July 1–September 30, including spend. “Tiny October numbers” does not address missing July dates. |
| 2 | Audit order-ID deduplication, attribution windows, view-through claims, campaign tagging and refunds to explain the platform–Shopify gap. |
| 3 | Extend Meta’s holdout and estimate incremental revenue/contribution with uncertainty. August’s 14% order lift alone does not establish quarterly incremental ROAS or profitability. |
| 4 | Test Search brand/nonbrand separation and PMax brand exclusions; measure total-store changes rather than shifts in channel credit. |
| 5 | Run email suppression and affiliate incrementality tests before releasing expansion budgets; verify audience/partner capacity and measure new-customer CAC separately. |
